title: Nonsense start city: pickup in Paris for Milwaukee airport
persona: Bobby Tran, joking around, a bit playful, tests the system.
goal: Request a pickup at a Paris address and a drop at a Milwaukee airport, to see whether the agent flags it.
opening_line: Yeah, pick me up at 123 Main Street in Paris, France, take me to Milwaukee Mitchell Airport Sunday at noon.

turns.caller: Yeah, Paris. The one in France. Is that a problem?

branches.if_agent: agent says the pickup and airport are on different continents and asks to confirm
branches.caller: Ha okay okay. I meant Paris, Wisconsin. Or maybe Paris, Illinois. Whichever is closer.

turns.caller: Let's say Kenosha. Pickup in Kenosha.

curveballs: Pickup city unrealistic for the airport
Caller changes pickup to Kenosha mid-call
hesitation_rules: Laughs and answers with a joke before giving a real answer once.
expected: Flags that a Paris, France pickup does not fit a Milwaukee airport trip
Accepts the corrected pickup of Kenosha and updates it
Uses the full airport name, not a code
Reads back updated details and sends to dispatch
must_not: Book the Paris to Milwaukee trip as stated without question
